seo.title: Muhammad Saad — Software Engineer
seo.description: I build systems that tell you when they've failed.

hero.subCopy: I build the systems behind AI apps: an API that pulls clean data from any webpage, sign-language recognition that runs entirely in your browser, and bookkeeping software that shows its own math.

about.heading: The same decision, in five different systems.
paragraphs: When a system can't do what it was asked, the interesting engineering question isn't how to make it succeed anyway — it's how to make the failure visible, specific, and impossible to mistake for success.

A parser that returns a bot wall as if it were an article, a sign-recognition model that scores a static pose as a moving sign, a tracking pipeline that applies a malformed status update: each of those is the same mistake wearing a different domain.
I'm an AI/ML intern at KnevaTech, I co-founded QuickSign with Abdur Rafay Khan, and I'm studying Computer Science at FAST-NUCES, Lahore.
